<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">

    <text x="20" y="140" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">Have a question, idea, or project in mind?</text>
    <text x="20" y="160" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">Tell us a little about it and our team will be in touch.</text>
  </g>

  <g>
    <text x="20" y="188" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">CONNECT WITH US</text>

    <circle cx="38" cy="216" r="8" fill="#FFFFFF"/>

    <text x="258" y="220" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="13px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Instagram</text>

  <!-- Contact form -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="263" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Your name</text>
    <text x="354" y="263" text-anchor="end" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">Required</text>

    <text x="38" y="299" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">Alex Morgan</text>

    <text x="20" y="344" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Email address</text>
    <text x="354" y="344" text-anchor="end" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">Required</text>
    <rect x="20" y="353" width="350" height="44" rx="22" fill="#232428" stroke="#383A41" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="38" y="380" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">alex.morgan@email.com</text>

    <text x="20" y="425" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#FFFFFF">Subject</text>

    <rect x="20" y="515" width="350" height="92" rx="18" fill="#232428" stroke="#383A41" stroke-width="2"/>
    <text x="38" y="542" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">I’d love to learn more about</text>
    <text x="38" y="563" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="14px" font-weight="400" fill="#D9D9D9">working together on our next idea.</text>
    <text x="350" y="590" text-anchor="end" font-family="Satoshi, sans-serif" font-size="12px" font-weight="400" fill="#DADADA">0 / 500</text>
